items.example: "I'll clean my room tomorrow." "Yeah, right."
items.exampleTr: "Odamı yarın toplarım." "Evet, tabii."
items.simple: You say it when you do not believe the other person at all.

items.example: "This traffic is awful." "Tell me about it!"
items.exampleTr: "Bu trafik berbat." "Hiç sorma!"
items.simple: You say it when you already know and feel the same.

items.example: "It's raining." "No kidding, I'm soaking wet."
items.exampleTr: "Yağmur yağıyor." "Yok artık, sırılsıklam oldum."
items.simple: You can say it when you are surprised, or when something is very clear.
items.note: Şaşkınlık ya da 'belli ya!' anlamında alaycı.

items.example: I said it tongue in cheek, so don't take it seriously.
items.exampleTr: Şaka yollu söyledim, ciddiye alma.
items.simple: You say something as a joke, but your face looks serious.

items.example: Oh, great. Now the bus is late too.
items.exampleTr: Oh, harika. Şimdi de otobüs geç kaldı.
items.simple: You say something is good, but it is really bad.

items.example: "The shop is closed." "You don't say!"
items.exampleTr: "Dükkan kapalı." "Hadi canım!"
items.simple: You answer like this when the news is not news at all.

items.tr: Ne tesadüf, tam da bundan bahsediyordum
items.example: Funny you should say that. I was just thinking about her.
items.exampleTr: Ne tesadüf. Tam da onu düşünüyordum.
items.simple: You say it when what they said is like what you just thought.

items.example: Don't be so sarcastic. I'm trying to help.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar iğneleyici olma. Yardım etmeye çalışıyorum.
items.simple: You say the opposite of what you mean to be a bit mean or funny.

items.example: She's incredibly witty and always makes us laugh.
items.exampleTr: İnanılmaz nükteli ve bizi hep güldürür.
items.simple: Quick and clever at saying funny things.

items.example: There's a lot of friendly banter in our team.
items.exampleTr: Ekibimizde bol dostane şakalaşma var.
items.simple: Playful talk between friends where they tease each other.

items.example: He has such a deadpan sense of humour.
items.exampleTr: Çok ifadesiz yüzlü bir mizah anlayışı var.
items.simple: Funny, but the face stays serious and does not smile.

items.example: That's the cheesiest joke I've ever heard!
items.exampleTr: Bu duyduğum en bayat şaka!
items.simple: So silly and old that it makes you smile and groan.

items.example: I cringe when I hear my old voice messages.
items.exampleTr: Eski sesli mesajlarımı duyunca utançtan kasılıyorum.
items.simple: You feel a bit sick and shy for someone doing something silly.

items.example: He made a wisecrack about my haircut.
items.exampleTr: Saçım hakkında iğneleyici bir espri yaptı.
items.simple: A quick funny thing said, a little bit unkind.

items.example: There's no need to be so snarky about it.
items.exampleTr: Bu konuda bu kadar laf sokmana gerek yok.
items.simple: Talking in a mean, funny way that hurts a little.

items.example: I forgot the punchline, so the joke was ruined.
items.exampleTr: Esprinin son cümlesini unuttum, şaka mahvoldu.
items.simple: The last part of a joke, the part that makes people laugh.

items.example: I knew it was a joke, so I just played along.
items.exampleTr: Şaka olduğunu biliyordum, ben de oyuna uydum.
items.simple: You act like you believe it, so the fun can go on.

items.example: He cracked a joke to break the tension.
items.exampleTr: Gerginliği kırmak için bir espri patlattı.
items.simple: You say something funny, quickly, and people laugh.

items.example: They love to poke fun at each other's accents.
items.exampleTr: Birbirlerinin aksanıyla dalga geçmeyi severler.
items.simple: You say funny things about someone, but not to be really mean.

items.example: My uncle has a very dry sense of humour.
items.exampleTr: Amcamın çok kuru bir mizah anlayışı var.
items.simple: He makes jokes in a quiet way, with a serious face.

items.example: Relax, can't you take a joke?
items.exampleTr: Rahat ol, şaka kaldıramaz mısın?
items.simple: You laugh when people play with you and you do not get upset.

items.en: I was only joking. Relax, I was only joking!
items.example: Relax, I was only joking!
items.exampleTr: Sakin ol, sadece şaka yapıyordum!
items.simple: You tell someone it was not true and not serious.

items.en: Very funny. Very funny, now give it back.
items.example: Very funny. Now give me my keys back.
items.exampleTr: Çok komik. Şimdi anahtarlarımı geri ver.
items.simple: You say it when a joke is not funny to you at all.

items.en: You had to be there. It's hard to explain, you had to be there.
items.example: It was hilarious. I guess you had to be there.
items.exampleTr: Çok komikti. Sanırım orada olman gerekirdi.
items.simple: You cannot make the story funny now, because the fun was in that moment.
